magic-arrow.name: Magic Arrow
magic-arrow.description: Launch a razor of focused mana that slices through the air toward your target.

weaken-curse.name: Weaken Curse
weaken-curse.description: Unfurl a rippling curse that saps the strength of bricks caught in its wave.

sand-storm.name: Sand Storm
sand-storm.description: Summon a whirling storm of scouring grit that grinds forward, shredding bricks until the vortex collapses.

void-darts.name: Darts of the Void
void-darts.description: Unleash darts of metal and void energy that damage targets.

electric-shards.name: Electric Shards
electric-shards.description: Launch crackling shards that drift unpredictably and arc electricity between targets.

ring-of-fire.name: Ring of Fire
ring-of-fire.description: Conjure an expanding crown of flame that scorches bricks as it races outward.

magic-storm.name: Magic Storm
magic-storm.description: Open a rift above the battlefield, raining arcane bolts into a focused zone.
